title: Touge King the Spirits 2 (Demo)
native_title: 峠キング・ザ・スピリッツ２
overview:
Touge King the Spirits 2 is a 3D racing game about one-on-one battles on winding mountain pass roads. Pick your car, take on a rival through tight hairpins and forest-lined switchbacks, and chase the best lap and total times.

Before each battle, fine-tune your machine's setup - adjust grip, braking and gearing - to suit the course, then head out to prove who rules the pass.

This disc is a demo version of the game.

- 1-2 players
- Car setting screen for grip, brakes and gear ratios
- Racing controller and 3D Control Pad support
